item.description: CRUD against the Sunbird registry (Insurance schema) used by the KBI flow. Run 'Create Policy (Identity)' first: it generates a random identity and stores it in the environment as sunbird_individual_id (policy number) / sunbird_full_name / sunbird_dob, then '5 — Sunbird KBI' authenticates against it. These dedicated vars keep the MOSIP individual_id (folders 1-3) untouched. 'Delete Policy' is opt-in (sunbird_cleanup=true) so it does not run automatically before KBI. Requires {{sunbird_url}} reachable.
